description_zh: 对向行驶的车辆(ego)经过一辆停在同向车道让行的Waymo AV时，其驾驶员侧后视镜与AV传感器发生侧擦，选择对向车为ego测试其通过静止车辆时的横向安全距离控制。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling westbound on Waller Street when it yielded to an oncoming passenger vehicle. As the passenger vehicle passed the stopped Waymo AV, its driver side rearview mirror made contact with a Waymo AV sensor.
Vehicle was: Stopped in Traffic (checked) for Waymo AV; Vehicle 2 was: Moving (checked), Proceeding Straight (checked)
evidence.reason: 对向车辆(vehicle 2)为移动方，驾驶决策值得测试，停止的AV作为静止oncoming障碍，侧镜擦碰表明横向间距极小(lateral=0.1)，现有词汇表可表达为oncoming+static_hold。
